about:
# Looti - Loot Notification System

Looti is a **small, highly customisable loot notification addon for World of Warcraft**. It shows **scrolling on-screen loot alerts** for every item, currency and coin you loot, so you can see your drops without reading chat. Use the **minimum rarity slider** to hide junk, **whitelist and blacklist** items or whole categories, and put the drops you're farming on the **watchlist** to get a sound, a star and a highlight when they drop. 

It works on **Retail, Classic Era, Hardcore, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Anniversary and WoW Forever**, in every client language. It uses the game's own API plus one small library for the settings window, so it costs very little performance and there's **not much that can break** between patches. 

I want this project to be as community involved as possible, so please feel free to comment or message me ideas!

Happy Looting!

## **Key Features at a Glance**

**Moveable & Customisable**: Position notifications anywhere with full control over size, transparency, layout, and timings

**Watchlist**: Add the items you're farming and get a sound, a star and a highlight when they drop

**Filtering**: Whitelist/blacklist items by ID, link, name or category (gear, consumables, crafting mats, BoE/BoP, and more)

**Rarity Control**: Set a minimum item quality so junk stays hidden

**Display**: Toggle icons, quantities, bag totals, item level, rarity colours, text outlines, scroll direction, and background visibility

**Every Version**: Retail, Classic Era & Hardcore, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Anniversary and WoW Forever, in every client language

## Installation

Download: [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/looti) | [GitHub releases](https://github.com/FinMckinnon/Looti/releases)

To install Looti, download **Looti.zip** then place it into your Addons folder for your World of Warcraft installation, regularly at `C:\Program Files (x86)\World of Warcraft\#GAMEVERSION#\Interface\AddOns` where GAMEVERSION represents your Game Version of World of Warcraft.

---

## **Features & Customisation**

#### **Getting Started**

Type this command in the chat window to open the settings:

/looti

---

#### **Loot Notifications Your Way**

- **Enable/Disable Loot Alerts**: Toggle notifications for item drops, money (gold, silver, copper) and currencies.
- **Bought, Rewarded & Crafted Items**: Choose whether vendor purchases, quest rewards and crafted items show, since "You receive" isn't always loot.
- **Rarity Threshold**: Set a minimum item rarity to filter what appears in notifications.

---

#### **Display Settings**

- **Moveable Notification Frame**: Drag and position notifications anywhere on your screen, or reset them back to the default spot.
- **Scroll Direction**: Choose whether notifications scroll up or down.
- **Background Transparency**: Leave it off, or add a backdrop so the text is easier to read.
- **Toggle Quantities**: Display item counts for multi-stack loot.
- **Bag Totals**: See how many you now have in your bags next to what you looted, like Copper Ore x3 (27).
- **Toggle Icons**: Remove item icons for a minimalist look, or change their size.
- **Hide Icon Borders**: Zoom icons past the default Blizzard border, with a thin black border in its place.
- **Text Outline**: Add a normal or thick outline so the text stands out against busy backgrounds.
- **Item Level & Upgrades**: Show the item level on gear, with a green arrow when it's better than what you have equipped.
- **Rarity Colours**: Show item names in their rarity colour, or plain white.
- **Crafting Quality (Retail)**: Reagents and crafted items show their quality icon next to the name.
- **Transparency**: Fade the notifications so you can still see your loot without it getting in the way.
- **Scale**: Make your loot notifications as big or small as you need.

---

#### **Timing and Layout**

- **Notification Duration**: Control how long notifications remain on screen.
- **Delay Between Notifications**: Adjust the timing between each alert.
- **Max Notifications on Screen**: Prevent clutter by limiting the number of visible alerts.
- **Notification Layout**: Set where the icon and text sit, to fit the rest of your UI.
- **Mouseover Tooltips**: Hover a notification to see the item tooltip, and optionally freeze every notification while you read it.

---

**Filters**

**Whitelist & Blacklist Support**: Create custom filters using item IDs, item links (shift-click several at once), item names or categories to control exactly what you see.

**Watchlist**: Items on your watchlist always show, whatever your rarity filter, and play a sound, get a star and a highlight when they drop. Each of the three can be turned off.

Filter whole groups of items at once:

- Quest Items & Keys
- Consumables (Potions, Food, Bandages)
- Gear & Equipment
- Crafting Materials (Trade Goods, Gems, Recipes, ...)
- Miscellaneous (Mounts, Toys, Pet Items)
- Bind on Equip (BoE) & Bind on Pickup (BoP)

So if you only want to see BoEs, quest items or crafting mats, you can.

---

#### **Test Your Setup**

Once you've set Looti up to your liking, use the **"Test Looti"** button or type **/lootitest** to preview how notifications will appear, including a watchlist item.

#### [📺 Watch the video demonstration here!](https://imgur.com/j2ivMM5)

![Customise Looti how you want!](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1093/276/flixier-2025-02-10t15_25_58.png)

---
